reachability_signal: gcov shows _xmlschema line with time.strip was executed

contract_probe.before_run: ./miniruby -Ilib -e 'begin; Time.xmlschema("  \t  1985-04-12T23:20:50.52Z"); puts "ACCEPTED"; rescue ArgumentError => e; puts "REJECTED: #{e.message}"; end'
contract_probe.after_run: ./miniruby -Ilib -e 'begin; Time.xmlschema("  \t  1985-04-12T23:20:50.52Z"); puts "ACCEPTED"; rescue ArgumentError => e; puts "REJECTED: #{e.message}"; end'
contract_probe.expected_pass_condition: BEFORE returns REJECTED (or incorrect Time), AFTER returns ACCEPTED with correct Time

limitations: Requires miniruby built with lib/time.rb loaded; test time zone must not interfere
